forbidden: provenance (id-bearing; permitted only for the quorum distinctness predicate)
grade (configuration attribute: granted on actor, required on a source gate; never a token field)
note: A guard states a governance condition over declared token properties; it never computes. `tags` is a set of declared, non-id categories; membership (`contains`) is not computation, mirroring the quorum distinctness already evaluated over provenance. Which tags exist and what they trigger is policy. `grade` is a configuration attribute (granted on actor, required on a source gate), not a token property, and is therefore never guardable — listed explicitly in `forbidden`. This is the wall between an expressive notation and a programming language.
